title: Communication-Efficient LLM Adaptation over Decentralized GPU Meshes
abstract: arXiv:2609.14339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decentralized training enables large-model training over low-end GPUs and internet-grade connections, but communication along both data-parallel and pipeline-parallel axes becomes the primary bottleneck. We study post-pretraining adaptation in this setting. We propose an asynchronous two-circuit system: a fast compressed training circuit drives throughput using activation masking for pipeline-parallel (PP) transfer and compressed data-parallel (DP) synchronization, while a slow anchor circuit runs occasional unmasked forward--backward passes off the critical path. Then, we introduce a spectral correction optimizer that uses these delayed anchor priors to denoise masked gradients without blocking the fast stream. Although prior work has found aggressive activation compression unreliable, we show that masking supports post-pretraining adaptation at high compression rates when anchored this way. translated_title: 去中心化GPU网格上的高效通信大语言模型自适应
translated_abstract: 去中心化训练使得在低端GPU和互联网级连接上进行大模型训练成为可能，但沿数据并行和流水线并行两个维度的通信成为主要瓶颈。我们研究了该场景下的预训练后自适应问题。我们提出了一种异步双回路系统：快速压缩训练回路通过激活掩码进行流水线并行（PP）传输和压缩的数据并行（DP）同步来驱动吞吐量，而慢速锚定回路则在关键路径之外运行偶尔的未掩码前向-反向传播。随后，我们引入了一种谱校正优化器，利用这些延迟的锚定先验对掩码梯度进行去噪，而不会阻塞快速数据流。尽管先前的工作发现激进的激活压缩并不可靠，但我们证明，以这种方式锚定时，掩码技术能够支持高压缩率下的预训练后自适应。仅流水线并行压缩即可带来高达……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种异步双回路系统结合谱校正优化器，通过激活掩码与压缩同步技术在去中心化GPU网格上实现了通信高效的大语言模型预训练后自适应，即使在高压缩率下也能保持训练效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes an asynchronous two-circuit system with a spectral correction optimizer that achieves communication-efficient LLM post-pretraining adaptation over decentralized GPU meshes, showing that activation masking supports training even at high compression rates when properly anchored.
